units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:8:4">Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ</cite> <he>ויאות עד כדון אית ת׳ וכ׳</he> would that be right? there is still retribution (justice) in the world to come.

senses.gloss: answer, refutation. Y. Shebu. III, 34ᶜ top כל יומוי … לא אשכחנן ת׳ וכ׳ as long as R. Ba bar M. lived, we found no answer; after his death we found an answer.
